tool_suggestions.title: Compliance Progress Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a dashboard to track and analyze the progress of compliance projects for Delve's internal use, helping ensure timely completion of certifications.
features: Overview of all ongoing compliance projects with status and progress
Detailed view for each project showing timeline and assigned experts
Automated alerts for projects behind schedule
Historical comparison of past project durations
Export project progress reports to CSV

tool_suggestions.title: Security Finding Triage Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a triage tool for Delve's team to efficiently review and manage security scan findings, ensuring prompt resolution and prioritization based on severity.
features: List view of all unresolved scan findings with severity indicators
Detail view for each finding, including description and remediation steps
Filter findings by severity and status
Assign findings to team members for resolution
Generate summary reports of resolved vs. unresolved findings

tool_suggestions.title: Client Subscription and Status Manager
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build an interface for Delve employees to manage client subscriptions and track compliance statuses, optimizing customer interactions and service.
features: List of all client companies with subscription tiers and current status
Detailed view of client compliance projects and timelines
Modify and update subscription details and status
Send automated alerts to clients for upcoming renewals or project deadlines
Analytics on subscription trends and MRR changes
